cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:2c.title: Fire Sprinkler Designer
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:2c.description: Our client is a leader in the fire protection industry. We are looking for a Fire Sprinkler Designer, responsible for producing code-compliant, constructible fire sprinkler system designs from concept through permit approval and construction support. Self-directed designer with deep knowledge of NFPA standards, strong field awareness, and proven experience using AutoSprink and / or Revit in a production environment. This role requires ownership of design quality, coordination, and constructability. Essential Duties & Responsibilities • Design and layout fire protection sprinkler systems—including wet, dry, pre-action, deluge, fire pumps, and tank systems—using specialized CAD software based on the AutoCAD (AutoSprink) and Revit. --AutoSprink experience highly desired. • Coordinate sprinkler system piping with architectural, structural, mechanical, and electrical building components. • Perform hydraulic calculations and convert design dimensions into fabrication-ready measurements. • Read and interpret construction documents, including drawings, specifications, and contracts. • Apply applicable NFPA standards based on building type, construction type, hazard classification, and architectural features. • Prepare complete design submittal packages and manage correspondence required to obtain design approvals and permits. • Review work orders, scope sheets, and procedural manuals to determine critical design requirements. • Prepare fabrication lists for pipe fabrication vendors and requisition materials as needed. • Conduct field surveys and field checks to verify design accuracy and suitability for installation. • Assist field personnel with design-related installation questions and resolve design issues during construction. Coordinate with Estimation, Design Management, Operations, and other internal teams to meet project schedules and delivery dates. • Communicate with AHJs, contractors, and other trades to ensure compliance and coordination. • Support permitting and inspection processes, including preparation of required documentation. • Participate in pre-design, coordination, and review meetings. • Identify opportunities for cost savings, efficiency improvements, and quality enhancement. • Prepare and submit final job close-out documents following acceptance testing. • Adhere to company safety policies and maintain a professional, customer-focused approach. Skills & Competencies • 5+ years of fire protection design experience. • Proven experience with AutoSprink or HydraCAD and / or Revit. • NICET Level III–IV certification in Water-Based Systems Layout preferred. • Strong working knowledge of NFPA 13, NFPA 13R, NFPA 13D, and related standards. • Experience with BIM coordination and designing fire sprinkler systems across multiple system types and manufacturers. • Strong understanding of NFPA standards and applicable codes (IFC, IBC, NEC). • Ability to visualize 3D concepts and solve mathematical problems involving geometry and algebra. • Skilled in reading and interpreting architectural, mechanical, and electrical drawings. • Maintain accurate, auditable records and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. • Strong attention to detail with emphasis on accuracy and quality. • Ability to obtain and maintain required national, state, and local licenses. • Ability to travel in area as needed.

You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in culinary techniques, cooking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Savory plays a key role in inspiring a love for cooking while driving sales of cookware, cutlery, and kitchen tools through hands-on savory classes and engaging culinary instruction. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). ghj-ghj:lever:1349bf72-6ad6-4926-b823-64.title: Controller
ghj-ghj:lever:1349bf72-6ad6-4926-b823-64.description: GHJ Search & Staffing is partnering with a successful, privately held company in the agriculture and organic produce industry to identify a hands-on Controller for its Bakersfield headquarters. Reporting directly to the CFO, the Controller will lead a four-person accounting team and take ownership of the company's core accounting operations, financial reporting, controls, and close processes. This is not a purely oversight-focused Controller position. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating at both the leadership and transactional levels—developing the accounting team while personally getting into journal entries, reconciliations, general ledger activity, financial reporting, and accounting issues when needed. The opportunity is particularly well suited for a Controller or experienced Accounting Manager who enjoys working in a smaller, entrepreneurial environment and wants significant visibility and the opportunity to expand their responsibilities over time. Lead the accounting function and maintain ownership of accurate and timely month-end and year-end close. Remain actively involved in journal entries, account reconciliations, general ledger activity, and resolution of accounting discrepancies. Lead, mentor, and develop a four-person AP/AR accounting team. Oversee grower accounting, settlements, and reporting, ensuring accuracy and transparency. Prepare and review financial statements, budgets, forecasts, and variance analyses. Partner closely with the CFO on cash flow forecasting, budgeting, financial reporting, analysis, and business decision support. Maintain and strengthen internal controls and ensure compliance with GAAP and applicable financial requirements. Partner cross-functionally with sales, operations, and grower relations to understand how operational activity flows through the financial statements. Identify and implement accounting process, systems, reporting, and workflow improvements. Leverage technology and automation to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and scalability of the accounting function. Maintain effective financial reporting and accounting workflows within the company's ERP environment. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; Accounting preferred. 7+ years of progressive accounting experience with significant hands-on general ledger and close responsibility. Accounting management, Assistant Controller, Controller, or comparable leadership experience. Demonstrated experience leading and developing accounting staff. Strong knowledge of GAAP, accrual accounting, financial reporting, and internal controls. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Strong ERP/accounting systems experience. Agriculture, produce, food production/distribution, or another inventory-based industry background strongly preferred. Experience with grower accounting, settlements, farming operations, or agricultural accounting is highly desirable. Famous ERP experience is a plus. The ideal Controller combines strong technical accounting skills with a hands-on mentality. You enjoy leading people but don't believe a Controller title means stepping away from the accounting itself. You are someone who will dig into an unusual balance, prepare or review a journal entry, help resolve a reconciliation issue, improve a process, and work alongside the team when necessary. This is a highly visible position with direct access to the CFO and executive leadership and the opportunity to assume greater responsibility as the organization evolves. #GHJSS #LI-MO1

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0f4cda8a-4acc-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Funnels/Workflow based in Brazil. As Senior Product Manager, you will define the strategy and roadmap for two high-impact products focused on customer acquisition, monetization, and subscriber growth. You will lead the evolution of workflow automation and web-to-app conversion experiences that help developers turn subscriber behavior and web traffic into revenue. The role sits at the intersection of product strategy, growth experimentation, analytics, UX, and highly technical infrastructure. You will work closely with engineering, design, data, go-to-market teams, customers, and senior leadership to identify opportunities and turn them into scalable products. A strong analytical mindset will be essential, with hands-on use of data and metrics to understand customer behavior and guide product decisions. You will also need enough technical depth to understand APIs, data models, system architecture, and complex product logic while collaborating independently with engineering teams. This is a high-ownership, remote-first opportunity where your work can directly influence how millions of end users discover, purchase, and engage with subscription products. Own the product strategy, vision, and roadmap for the Funnels and Workflows product areas. Define a cohesive product direction that prioritizes customer value, business impact, experimentation, and sustainable growth. Lead the development of Workflows as an orchestration engine for paywalls, win-back offers, lifecycle campaigns, and other experiences triggered by subscriber behavior. Drive the evolution of Funnels as a web-to-app product designed to convert web traffic into paying mobile subscribers. Engage directly with prospective and existing customers to understand use cases, uncover adoption barriers, identify feature gaps, and help customers improve monetization outcomes. Proactively investigate customer and product problems rather than relying entirely on engineering or support teams to identify and diagnose issues. Partner with growth teams and customers to understand their objectives, challenges, experimentation needs, and monetization strategies. Identify, prioritize, and develop product features that allow customers to create compelling experiences, measure outcomes, and iterate quickly. Establish robust product metrics and use quantitative analysis to evaluate adoption, conversion, retention, revenue impact, and overall product performance. Work closely with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market teams to translate product opportunities into scalable solutions and bring them successfully to market. Understand the technical infrastructure behind the products and make informed decisions about APIs, data models, system complexity, risk logic, and dependencies. Break ambitious product initiatives into meaningful, achievable increments with clear priorities and realistic timelines. Collaborate directly with senior leadership to communicate product opportunities, strategy, progress, trade-offs, and expected impact. Continuously experiment, learn from results, and refine product strategy based on customer feedback and data. Act as a strong advocate for customers while maintaining a clear focus on helping them increase revenue, conversion, and subscriber growth. Requirements 5+ years of experience in product management, technical product engineering, analytics, or a closely related discipline, with meaningful experience contributing to the growth of mobile applications. Strong analytical capabilities and significant experience working directly with data to inform product strategy and decision-making. Advanced proficiency in SQL or comparable analytical tools, with the ability and willingness to independently investigate data and uncover actionable insights. jobgether-jobgether:lever:3dce40a2-967d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Organizational Change Management (OCM) Lead based in Germany. This role will lead the people side of complex, technology-enabled business transformations, with a strong focus on SAP and large-scale ERP implementations. You will shape change strategies that help organizations transition effectively to new processes, systems, and ways of working. The position combines stakeholder engagement, communications, organizational readiness, training, and adoption measurement. You will work across leadership teams, business stakeholders, project teams, and consulting partners to build alignment and momentum. A key focus will be helping manufacturing organizations navigate transformation while minimizing disruption and maximizing adoption. You will have significant ownership over OCM planning, execution, governance, and continuous monitoring throughout major initiatives. This is an opportunity for an experienced change leader to make a measurable impact across complex, enterprise-wide transformation programs. Develop and implement comprehensive Organizational Change Management strategies aligned with transformation objectives, project timelines, and business outcomes. Conduct stakeholder impact assessments, organizational readiness evaluations, and change impact analyses to identify affected groups, risks, and adoption requirements. Establish and manage change networks, champion programs, and stakeholder engagement structures that support sustained adoption. Design and execute communication strategies, including executive toolkits, targeted messaging, leadership communications, and employee engagement materials. Facilitate leadership alignment sessions, stakeholder workshops, and engagement activities across different organizational levels. Define appropriate OCM governance frameworks, roles, processes, and decision-making structures for large-scale transformation programs. Create or contribute to comprehensive training strategies that prepare employees for new systems, processes, and operating models. Manage key change deliverables, including readiness assessments, management toolkits, communication materials, training plans, and adoption metrics. Monitor change-related risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans throughout implementation. Track adoption and organizational readiness metrics, using insights to adjust change strategies and improve transformation outcomes. Collaborate effectively with client teams, consulting partners, complementary service providers, and other stakeholders to ensure coordinated delivery. Requirements Proven experience leading Organizational Change Management initiatives for large-scale ERP or technology-enabled business transformation programs. Strong knowledge of SAP platforms, with SAP S/4HANA experience strongly preferred, and an understanding of the related business processes and transformation impacts. Demonstrated experience developing change communication strategies, stakeholder engagement plans, readiness assessments, and adoption measurement frameworks. Strong knowledge of organizational design, transition planning, and change impact analysis. Experience working within or supporting manufacturing organizations is required. Excellent facilitation, presentation, communication, and collaboration skills across executive, management, and operational levels. Ability to build effective working relationships across client organizations, consulting teams, technology teams, and external partners. Strong ability to manage multiple change workstreams, deliverables, risks, and stakeholders within complex transformation environments. Experience participating in at least five major business change initiatives involving SAP or comparable ERP platforms is preferred. southparkcommons-orb:ashbyhq:3b256c0c-18.title: VP of Marketing- San Francisco HQ
southparkcommons-orb:ashbyhq:3b256c0c-18.description: About Orb: We’re a team that cares deeply about the work, the people we do it with, and the customers we do it for. Everyone at Orb has real ownership over their work, direct access to customers, and a voice in how the company grows. We’re building the revenue design platform that helps teams automate billing, evolve pricing, and grow revenue with confidence. Looking ahead, joining forces with Adyen expands what we can build and raises the ceiling on the problems we get to solve for customers. The challenges are uniquely interesting, and you’ll be surrounded by thoughtful, ambitious people who move fast and hold a high bar. For San Francisco Bay Area , New York, and Amsterdam residents, we've built a hybrid work culture where we are in office 3 days/week. For remote roles, we ask you to join us in person 1x per quarter. Our values, customer centricity, minutes matter, run with it, attention to detail, and go further together are at the core of everything we do. ABOUT THE ROLE: Marketing is the next unlock for Orb's growth. As part of Adyen, we're taking Orb toward a massive revenue line with Adyen's 2,000-person global sales org behind our distribution and a real opportunity to build a co-sell and partner marketing motion at scale. You get the reach of a platform business with the scrappiness, ownership, and speed of an early-stage team. Today most of our revenue comes inbound and we see demand generation as the unlock to even faster growth. We're looking for a full-funnel operator to own growth and integrated marketing end to end, someone who can shift us toward a more balanced outbound and ABM motion while raising the bar on brand, creative, and everything in between. This is a hands-on role for a builder, not a hands-off executive: you'll set the strategy and run the plays. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: - Own growth and integrated marketing strategy across owned and digital channels including web and digital marketing, paid advertising, demand generation, and creative strategy and brand output. - Lead demand generation as the primary growth lever, building programs that scale pipeline and revenue. - Shift Orb from a largely inbound business toward a more balanced outbound and ABM motion. - Build a co-sell and partner marketing motion in partnership with Adyen's global sales org. - Run integrated, full-funnel campaigns from global brand work through to scaled demand gen programs and events. - Partner closely with sales, product, and leadership to connect marketing directly to revenue. ABOUT YOU - A full-funnel marketer who thinks about growth holistically, from global brand campaigns all the way through to scaled demand generation programs. - Deep demand generation expertise is your primary strength, with product marketing exposure as a valuable secondary skill. - Hands-on experience with ABM and outbound motions, and a point of view on how to build them. - Breadth across integrated marketing, events, paid marketing, web and digital, and creative and brand. - A strong hands-on operator who's energized by building and executing in scrappy, early-stage mode not just directing from the top. - A collaborative partner to sales and product who ties marketing tightly to pipeline and revenue. - Some domestic and international travel required. Benefits: - Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance - One Medical membership - Unlimited PTO plus an additional week off between Christmas and New Year’s - 401k plan - 16-week paid parental leave with equity vesting - Commuter stipend - Catered lunches in the office - Annual learning & development stipend - Meaningful equity in the form of stock options Equal Opportunity Employer We work with each other day in and day out, and strongly believe that building a diverse and inclusive team is key to our long-term goals and success as a company. southparkcommons-recraft-ai:ashbyhq:be84.title: Performance Creative Designer
southparkcommons-recraft-ai:ashbyhq:be84.description: ABOUT US Founded in the US in 2022 and now based in London, UK, Recraft is an AI tool for professional designers, illustrators, and marketers, setting a new standard for excellence in image generation. We designed a tool that lets creators quickly generate and iterate original images, vector art, illustrations, icons, and 3D graphics with AI. Over 3 million users across 190+ countries have produced hundreds of millions of images using Recraft, and we're just getting started. Join a universe of professional opportunities, develop and support large-scale projects, and shape the future of creativity. We are committed to making Recraft an essential, daily tool for every designer and setting the industry standard. Our mission is to ensure that creators can fully control their creative process with AI, providing them with innovative tools to turn ideas into reality. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI, we want you on board! JOB DESCRIPTION Growth at Recraft runs on creative that's tested, not guessed at. We're looking for a Performance Creative Designer who can take that on as their own: reading what's working, turning that into the next round of ads, and shipping creative that holds up on Meta, Google, and TikTok. For the right person, this is a chance to build the performance creative function at Recraft from the ground up, with Recraft Studio itself as your day-to-day production tool. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Produce paid ad creative — static, motion, and UGC-style edits — for Meta, Google, and TikTok. - Own the creative testing pipeline end to end: form a hypothesis, ship it, read the results, and iterate on winners. - Translate performance data (hook rate, CTR) into the next round of creative yourself, rather than waiting for a brief. - Use Recraft Studio as your primary production tool, and feed what you learn back to the product team building it. - Keep the ad creative brandbook consistent while adapting tone by placement and audience. WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH You'll join the Marketing team and work closely with our Performance Marketing Manager, UA Manager, and Creative and product teams. This is a role built around bringing your own ideas to the table, not just executing against a detailed brief. REQUIREMENTS - 3+ years creating performance and paid-acquisition creative. - A portfolio of ads that actually ran, with context on what won and why. - Comfortable with both static and motion work: Figma or Photoshop, plus After Effects, Premiere, or CapCut. - Strong understanding of ad anatomy — hooks, the first three seconds, text hierarchy, platform specs, and policy limits. - Hands-on experience using AI image or video tools in a real production workflow. NICE TO HAVE - Experience with design tools, creative SaaS, or dev tools (Canva, Picsart, Photoroom, Figma-adjacent products). - Vector or 3D skills — a real differentiator given Recraft's vector and brand-style capabilities. - Ad copywriting — able to write your own headlines and hooks. - In-house experience at a product company, ideally with a subscription product. - Experience growing your own audience as a creator or influencer on Instagram or TikTok. WHAT WE OFFER - A full-time contractor engagement, fully remote, with compensation that matches the seniority and ownership this role carries. - Real ownership of the testing pipeline — from hypothesis to shipped ad to the next iteration, not just execution against someone else's brief. - A product built on AI image and video generation, growing fast, where your creative work has a direct, measurable line to company results. - The chance to be the first person to define what performance creative looks like at Recraft — your test results become the playbook everyone after you works from. - Direct collaboration with our Performance Marketing, UA, Creative, and product teams. - A team that means it when it says it wants to build the best product in the category — people who give each other direct, useful feedback,

southparkcommons-simular:ashbyhq:77e4a50.title: Product & User Operations Intern
southparkcommons-simular:ashbyhq:77e4a50.description: Where multiple locations are listed for this role, the position may be based in any of those locations, with priority determined according to the order of listing. Our users are doing things with autonomous agents that nobody has done before, which means they hit problems nobody has documented. Sitting between those users and the product team is one of the highest-signal seats in the company. You'll be the person who knows what users are actually struggling with, and who makes sure that knowledge reaches the people who can fix it. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Handle frontline user support: answer support email, Discord questions, and tickets clearly and quickly - Own the feedback loop from users into the product backlog: triage, categorize, and quantify what people are hitting - Support release operations: track what is shipping, write release notes, and verify things work as intended after they land - Maintain help docs, canned responses, and the knowledge base so common questions stop being asked twice - Track feature timelines, release notes, and delivery progress, and keep the team honest about dates - Monitor product metrics such as activation, retention, and feature adoption, and report what's changing - Run onboarding and activation analysis: find where new users stall, and propose product fixes rather than workarounds - Help operationalize agent quality: review real agent runs, catalogue failure modes, and feed them back to product and research - Advocate for the user in product discussions, with evidence rather than anecdote YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF - You're pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in any field, or equivalent experience - You write clearly and kindly, especially when replying to someone who is frustrated - You're organized and reliable, and you follow through without being chased - You're comfortable with data: you can pull numbers, spot a trend, and explain it - You're curious about how products get built and want to be close to that process - You can hold context across many small threads without dropping things Bonus: prior support, community, or product ops experience, or you've run a Discord community

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment isnot a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Commissions are paid every pay period - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek high-energy personalities that thrive in a fast-paced environment to provide a welcoming atmosphere for our Unlimited Wash Pass Members and a memorable first impression on our new car wash guests. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated and have an outgoing, friendly personality. All we ask is for you to share our passion for washing cars, creating memorable moments, and our obsession with exceptional guest service! Location: Speeders Car Wash 987 Rte 73 S, Marlton, NJ 08053
